data.why: The repo's own test fixtures (materials/fixtures/*.json) seed one system (MAPbCl3), property/unit/reference lists and a sample dataset so Search returns real results; dielectric_vs_temperature.txt is a small text file written to match the exact 'value temperature' per-line format the app's own 'autofill from file' button on the Add Data page parses (comment lines start with #), including an outlier and a line with a missing value.

goals: Search existing records for a material system (e.g. MAPbCl3) and filter by property (band gap, dielectric constant) and experimental vs. computational origin to compare values across studies
Submit a new experimental or computational dataset for a material via Add Data, attaching the literature reference, property, unit and sample type
Import raw measured data points quickly by uploading a plain-text file into the data-entry textarea instead of typing each value by hand
Attach supporting files (raw input files, sample images, synthesis notes) to a submitted dataset for reproducibility
As a staff user, verify a dataset submitted by another contributor before it counts as checked
View a dataset's values as a chart (property vs. property) to spot trends or outliers across a material's temperature/pressure series

review.summary: The goal and phases track the README's flow (search, contribute with sources and files, inspect/download, peer-verify), and most evidence holds. Three things keep it from filing as is: run-specific failures recorded as workflow tasks (t9, t10), a few mis-cited or overstated screens (t7, t1, t11), and gaps around the actual Add Data pickers, the reproducibility metadata and cross-study comparison.
